name: Quad Cities SVI Census Tracts
description: The 86 census tracts of CDC/ATSDR's Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) 2020 under SCOUT's Quad Cities flood grid, the extent of the quad-cities-flood-vulnerability depth rasters (longitude -90.6879 to -90.4253, latitude 41.4150 to 41.6242): every tract with some of its area on the grid, its outline cut 0.005 degrees past the grid and simplified by up to 0.000025 degrees, a quarter of a depth cell. CDC's columns: FIPS (the tract's code), LOCATION (its name), E_TOTPOP (its people, estimated) and RPL_THEMES (its overall SVI percentile ranking among every US tract, 0 to 1); the estimates are for the whole tract, and -999 marks a missing value, as CDC publishes it (none of these tracts has one). The quad-cities-flood-vulnerability test dataflow reads it. Acquired through the Discovery Catalog's ArcGIS Hub Open Data source (source.esri.hub-opendata@1): CDC's layer SVI2020 US tract, resource 3827cb5593174c79b35119611299279b_2 (https://hub.arcgis.com/datasets/3827cb5593174c79b35119611299279b_2, the layer https://services3.arcgis.com/ZvidGQkLaDJxRSJ2/arcgis/rest/services/CDC_ATSDR_Social_Vulnerability_Index_2020_USA/FeatureServer/2), downloaded whole on 2026-10-18 (sha256 831027ba7c3ed83cd3b040359bbc7afc8509acde6a17da0886ec96a5262073a9) by scripts/build_flood_vulnerability_datasets.py. Public domain: CDC/ATSDR asks to be cited as the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention/Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry/Geospatial Research, Analysis, and Services Program, CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2020 Database US, https://www.atsdr.cdc.gov/place-health/php/svi/index.html.
